description: M9.2 MCP tool manifest. Declares the six adapter-contract operations as MCP tools, with input schemas and descriptions. Handlers in scripts/_mcp.py are thin wrappers over existing scripts (context.sh, decisions.sh, worker.sh) — MCP is a transport, not new orchestration. See docs/m9-adapter-pattern.md for the contract semantics.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Return the continuity layer's identity descriptor for the MCP-side adapter. Static; used by MCP clients to discover layer-side capabilities. Maps to AdapterIdentity from core/schemas/adapter-identity.schema.json.

tools.name: read_context
tools.description: Return the 60-second context snapshot (M7 artifact). Thin wrapper over `scripts/context.sh --json`. The MCP and shell paths produce identical bytes.

format.description: M9.2 v1: json only. markdown format deferred until a real MCP server transport surfaces a need (the markdown render exists at core/context-snapshot.md if a caller needs it).

tools.name: read_decisions
tools.description: Return decision-entry rows from the M8 log, newest first. Thin wrapper over `scripts/decisions.sh list --json` with optional filters.

adapter.description: filter to this adapter brand only

limit.description: cap to last N entries (0 = no cap)

tools.name: append_decision
tools.description: Append a decision-entry to the M8 log. Thin wrapper over `scripts/decisions.sh add`. The submit handler synthesizes id/ts/schema_version. Returns the new entry's sha256 decision_id.

adapter.description: adapter brand to attribute this decision to

repo.description: default: derive from git toplevel, or 'unknown'

tools.name: claim_task
tools.description: Find the first queued task matching the filter and claim it. Wraps `scripts/worker.sh list --state queued` + filtering + `scripts/worker.sh claim`. M9.2 v1: caller declares its adapter id via `as_adapter_id`; the worker id is `mcp:<as_adapter_id>` so audit transitions visibly attribute the operator-mediated MCP path (parallels M9.1's `bundle:<adapter_id>`). Returns the claimed task or null when nothing matches.

adapter.description: worker.sh claim adapter. Local CLI agents use claude/codex; web model brands are normally operator-mediated through bundle/MCP transports and still require matching trust policy.

as_adapter_id.description: caller's adapter_id (typically the value returned by whoami on the calling side). Embedded into worker id as `mcp:<as_adapter_id>`.

kind.description: filter to this task kind only

repo.description: filter to this repo only (matches task.input.repo)

trust_level.description: filter to this trust level only

tools.name: submit_result
tools.description: Submit a worker-result for a claimed/running task. Thin wrapper over `scripts/worker.sh submit`. The result may include `decisions[]` which flow through the M8.3 writeback path (auto-injected `task:<task_id>` ref). Returns the post-transition status plus the appended_decision_ids.

result.description: worker-result object; validated by worker.sh submit. Optional `decisions[]` triggers M8.3 writeback.

as_adapter_id.description: caller's adapter_id; must match the original claim's worker id (mcp:<as_adapter_id>).

needs_approval.description: if true, route to awaiting-approval instead of completed

fail.description: if true, route to failed instead of completed
